tool_input.command:
set -u
t=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$t/dest"
for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000 20260104-000000 20260105-000000 20260106-000000; do
  printf 'a\n' > "$t/dest/demo-$s.tar.gz"; printf 'x  demo-%s.tar.gz\n' "$s" > "$t/dest/demo-$s.tar.gz.sha256"
done
echo "--- rotate 6 archives keep 2 (--keep=N form, sidecars) ---"
bash rotate.sh --dest="$t/dest" --name demo --keep=2
echo "remaining: $(ls "$t/dest" | sort | tr '\n' ' ')"
echo "--- dry-run + short flags ---"
bash rotate.sh -n -q --dest "$t/dest" --name demo -k 2 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- help exits 0, unknown option exits 1, bad --keep exits 1 ---"
bash rotate.sh --help >/dev/null; echo "help rc=$?"
bash verify.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name=nope >/dev/null; echo "verify --name= rc=$?"
bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep x 2>/dev/null; echo "bad keep rc=$?"
bash verify.sh --dest "$t/dest" --keep 3 >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "verify --keep accepted rc=$?"
rm -rf "$t"
tool_input.description: Exercise rotate/verify flags and the deletion path
